National Monthly GST Revenue Summary

Source: R/gst_new_functions.R
gst_revenue_summary.Rd

Returns a tidy data.table of national monthly GST revenue broken down by all five components (CGST, SGST, IGST, Cess, Total) for a chosen category from gross_net_collection.

gst_revenue_summary(
  financial_year = NULL,
  category = "gross_revenue",
  include_yoy = TRUE
)

Arguments

financial_year

Character scalar or NULL (default). E.g. "2024-25". When NULL all available years are returned.

category

Character scalar. One of "gross_revenue" (default), "domestic", "igst_import", "refund", "net_revenue".

include_yoy

Logical. If TRUE (default) appends a yoy_pct column showing year-on-year growth in total.

Value

A data.table with columns: financial_year, month_date, category, cgst, sgst, igst, cess, total, and optionally yoy_pct.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Gross revenue for FY 2024-25
gst_revenue_summary(financial_year = "2024-25")

# Net revenue across all years, no YoY column
gst_revenue_summary(category = "net_revenue", include_yoy = FALSE)
} # }
